name: Jack Reeve
about: Hi, I'm Jack, and I'm an 18 year old engineer who likes to buy, restore, and sell cars for fun. I've had a love for cars ever since I built my first kitcar with my dad when I was 12; an Mazda MX5 based Exocet, which has recently been used as a factory demo car! Since then, I've started to work on some of my own cars, ranging from other Locost kitcars to, more recently, my very own 1999 Saab 9-3 sleeper. I've also started to further develop some of my CAD skills, and I am currently in the process of expanding and updating my portfolio. Feel free to check out my progress by using the projects tab above!
